claims.table: S2 Data, age-stratified type 2 diabetes relative risks
claims.population: Austrian inpatients with claims in 2006–2007, grouped by age. The study used ICD-10 E11 to identify type 2 diabetes and excluded patients who died during the period.
claims.limits: These are age-band relative risks from the published co-occurrence analysis. A blank p-value means the supplement did not supply a test result. A row by itself does not establish a supported association. The original ICD-10 category and its same-code U.S. catalog anchor can have different definitions.
claims.coverage: The authors tested 1,051 ICD-10 categories. S2 Data contains rows for a subset of the categories tested. Links use same-code, three-character category anchors.

cohorts.cohortLabel: England CPRD Aurum lung cancer cohort
cohorts.population: 69,674 adults with newly documented lung cancer in England, 2010–2022. Diabetes was defined by a qualifying code recorded before the first lung cancer code.
cohorts.timeWindow: Pre-existing documented T2D at the first recorded lung cancer diagnosis.

groups.present: Eligible adults with newly recorded lung cancer

cohorts.mapping: C34 anchors the paper’s SNOMED CT-defined lung cancer phenotype. The estimate covers the full eligible study cohort.
cohorts.limitations: The denominator comprises lung cancer cases. This study estimate does not supply the diabetes prevalence in people without lung cancer, or a lung-cancer risk ratio.

rows.excerpt: Out of the final study population, 20.9% of people had T2DM.

cohorts.cohortLabel: UK Biobank age- and sex-matched cross-sectional cohort
cohorts.population: 21,935 participants with T2D, matched one-to-one to age- and sex-matched participants without T2D.
cohorts.timeWindow: Recorded diagnoses during the study surveillance period ending in 2019.
cohorts.mapping: The code is a navigation anchor for the study-defined phenotype. Ascertainment used diagnoses and other data sources specific to each condition.
cohorts.limitations: UK Biobank is a volunteer cohort. Matching and comparator selection affect these proportions. The estimates describe documented co-prevalence.

rows.phenotype: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (study definition includes spirometry)

cohorts.population: Adults aged 16 or older with recently diagnosed T2D in English general practices, with up to five diabetes-free comparators matched on age, sex, and practice.
cohorts.timeWindow: Condition recorded in or before 2014 among patients contributing throughout 2014. Study definitions applied additional rules for selected diagnoses.
cohorts.mapping: The ICD-10-CM code is a catalog anchor for the clinical phenotype measured in the study. The source definition governs both conditional rows.
cohorts.limitations: Reported fractions are rounded in the paper. The matched prevalence describes recorded disease history in that year. Use the cited clinical phenotype and cohort for interpretation.

cohorts.population: 169,262 eligible ischemic stroke events in Denmark. The study excluded intracerebral hemorrhage and coexisting type 1 diabetes.
cohorts.timeWindow: Documented type 2 diabetes at an eligible ischemic stroke event.
cohorts.mapping: I63 is the catalog anchor for ischemic stroke in the study. The estimate uses all eligible ischemic events and carries no subtype-specific estimate.
cohorts.limitations: The denominator is events. A patient could contribute more than one event. Case ascertainment used registry diagnoses and glucose-lowering treatment history. The study supplies no stroke-free comparator for this estimate.

rows.excerpt: The study included 169,262 IS events; 24,479 with co-morbid T2D.

cohorts.cohortLabel: Danish early-stage breast cancer and matched comparison cohorts
cohorts.population: Danish women aged 30–99 with incident early-stage breast cancer during 1996–2021, plus matched cancer-free women. The study excluded women with prior diabetes or prior cancer, except nonmelanoma skin cancer.
cohorts.timeWindow: Five years of follow-up starting six months after breast cancer diagnosis or the corresponding matched index date.
cohorts.table: Figure 1 and Results, overall cumulative incidence
cohorts.mapping: C50 anchors early-stage breast cancer survivorship in this cohort. Use the stated landmark, horizon, and eligibility.
cohorts.limitations: These are published cumulative incidences accounting for death as a competing event. This estimate describes newly diagnosed type 2 diabetes during follow-up. It does not provide diabetes prevalence at diagnosis.
